messages:
Alex: saw a public forked PR with a blob that decodes to a GCP service account JSON. appears to be a long-lived key. filing here for triage.
Priya: can you paste the snippet (redact client IDs)?
Alex: pasted: `{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-prod","private_key_id":"b4f...","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIEvQIBADANBgkq...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}`
Jun: ouch. which repo/PR?
Alex: partner-repo: partner/inbound#372, user=contrib42. PR description mentions they tested webhook with a sample payload and included the key by accident.
Sam: immediate actions: 1) mark credential compromised 2) revoke key 3) rotate any dependent infra creds 4) notify partner security + legal if scope is wide.
Nico: agree. i can run gcloud to list where this SA has roles and revoke keys. Priya: do we own that SA or partner? project_id is redwood-prod so it's ours.
Priya: if it's our SA, revoke immediately. which key id? Alex: `b4f1c2d3...`
Nico: running: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod`
Nico: found two keys: one matches `b4f1c2d3` (created 2024-08-12), other is newer. deleting compromised key now. `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete b4f1c2d3 --iam-account=ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod`
oncall-bot: action: service-account-key-deleted event recorded. incident-sev:high.
Jun: confirm consumers: check CI configurations, lambda envs, k8s secrets that reference that key. Sam: i'll grep deploy pipelines and k8s secrets. Priya: also check Vault transit usage — maybe the key was exported or used to wrap payloads.
Sam: grepping repos now. found an older CI job that writes raw SA keys to `tmp/` during integration tests in partner-runner image. that job uses the older key. i'll patch CI to stop writing plaintext and rotate job to use workload identity.
Alex: partner said they created PR to reproduce a failure and copied the key from a dev mailbox. they will immediately remove PR and do forced push. ask them to delete fork too.
Priya: we need a controlled rotation plan: 1) revoke key (done) 2) create new key, 3) update all consumers, 4) search logs/archives for plaintext exposures, 5) update runbooks + CI lint rules. owners?
Nico: i'll own key creation and IAM role audit. ETA 30m to create new key and list bindings.
Sam: i'll push CI patch to stop writing keys to disk and add a pre-commit secret-scan in partner's repo. will request partner to accept PR. ETA 1h.
Jun: i'll run storage and logs scan for any copies: GCS buckets, logs-export BigQuery, and stackdriver traces. give me 2h.
Priya: we should also enable audit-logging alert for service account key creation/deletion across org. Sam: we have alert but not tuned for SA keys. i'll create an alert that pages on key create/delete for prod SAs.
Alex: legal wants a timeline and evidence of deletion from partner. partner responded: "we reverted PR and deleted the fork at 2026-03-21T15:12Z, apologies."
oncall-bot: incident-sev:high -> monitor. add checklist item: KMS/Vault correlation.
Priya: question: was this key ever wrapped with Vault transit or KMS? if so we need to rotate transit keys as well. Jun: searching Vault audit logs for `ingest-sa` and `private_key` usage.
Jun: found no vault:transit/encrypt calls containing that SA key; it looks the key was copied in plaintext from dev mailbox and committed. no KMS wrapping.
Priya: good — simpler. still, let's run an RBAC sweep: who had access to that mailbox and CI runner that could have leaked it. Leo: (not in thread) we should ensure least privilege on dev mailboxes.
Nico: new key created: key id `c9e7...` and attached previous roles. updating deployment manifests to use new key is in progress.
Sam: partner accepted CI fix and merged pre-commit secret-scan. i'm promoting to partner staging now.
Jun: logs scan: found one archived copy in a GCS bucket `partner-dev-uploads` with object path `tmp/PR-372/sa.json` from 2025-11-02. i'm initiating object deletion and retention override request.
Priya: owners reconfirm: Nico -> rotate/create keys + IAM audit; Sam -> CI fixes + alerting; Jun -> log/archive purge + evidence collection; Alex -> partner comms & legal handoff.
Nico: IAM audit shows ingest-sa had roles: roles/pubsub.publisher on topic ingest-topic, roles/storage.objectViewer on partner-bucket. no owner-level roles. proposing to narrow to least-needed and enable conditional bindings for time-limited access.
Sam: PR to infra-lint repo created to add secret-scan to all partner-runner images and block PRs with base64-encoded private key patterns.
oncall-bot: action: evidence bundle created and uploaded to case system.
Alex: can we add a preventive guard in Vault: disallow storing plaintext SA JSON in generic secrets path? maybe enable structured secret schema and validators.
Priya: good idea. let's add a validator in Vault write plugin for `secret/data/` paths that rejects keys matching SA JSON regex and suggest use of KMS-based key import or Workload Identity. Sam: i'll prototype policy.
Jun: final ask: update post-incident runbook with steps: detection grep commands, gcloud key delete commands, evidence collection locations, partner comms template. i'll draft and share.
Alex: thanks team. marking this as contained for now; will reopen if more exposures pop up. :thumbsup:
